name.purpose: The page name in the header, in the accent color.

body.purpose: Base text. Table titles and the done count use this size at weight 500.

small.purpose: Controls, topic names, level, status, index rows, table cells, and the legend.

label.purpose: Field labels, the column heads of Today, and table heads, in Quiet Ink.

code-letter.purpose: The letter in a topic code.

motion.name: tint-hover
motion.purpose: Hover is an 8 percent mix of Ink into Sheet. Active is 14 percent. A rating button uses 11 percent at rest and 20 percent on hover. Off under prefers-reduced-motion. No keyframes.

openItems: At 375 pixels the table of all problems scrolls sideways inside its wrapper.

components.name: Button
components.description: The Solution button, Export, and every other plain control.
components.css: .ds-sheet-bg { background: var(--sheet, #fbfdfc); padding: 1rem; border-radius: 1.25rem; } .ds-btn { font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink, #1d2b2e); background: var(--sheet, #fbfdfc); border: 1px solid var(--edge, #6f7f80); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #1d2b2e) 8%, var(--sheet, #fbfdfc)); } .ds-btn:active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #1d2b2e) 14%, var(--sheet, #fbfdfc)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2c6769); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Rating Buttons
components.description: Three pills. Each has a color dot and its word. The pressed one fills with its color.
components.css: .ds-rate { display: flex; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 1.25rem; background: var(--sheet, #fbfdfc); } .ds-r { --c: var(--clean, #256a4c); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--c); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 11%, var(--sheet, #fbfdfc)); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem 0.375rem 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-struggled { --c: var(--struggled, #7c5512); } .ds-failed { --c: var(--failed, #a23f3c); } .ds-dot { width: 0.625rem; height: 0.625rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); } .ds-r:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 20%, var(--sheet, #fbfdfc)); } .ds-on, .ds-on:hover, .ds-on:active { background: var(--c); color: var(--sheet, #fbfdfc); } .ds-on .ds-dot { background: var(--sheet, #fbfdfc); } .ds-r:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2c6769); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-sheet { background: var(--sheet, #fbfdfc); color: var(--ink, #1d2b2e); border-radius: 1.25rem; padding: 1.5rem; } .ds-entry { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.375rem 0.75rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6e0de); } .ds-entry:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-no { color: var(--accent, #2c6769); font-weight: 500; } .ds-title { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #1d2b2e); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: var(--edge, #6f7f80); text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-title:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--accent, #2c6769); } .ds-title:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2c6769); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-topic { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-code { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.375rem; height: 1.375rem; margin-right: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #2c6769) 18%, var(--sheet, #fbfdfc)); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .ds-lv { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-2, #4d5f62); } .ds-st { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-new { font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink-2, #4d5f62); }

components.name: Topic Index Row
components.description: A code circle, the topic name, the reviewed count, and the weak count.
components.css: .ds-idx { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.375rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto 1.375rem; gap: 0.375rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d6e0de); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink, #1d2b2e); } .ds-icode { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 1.375rem; height: 1.375rem; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #2c6769) 18%, var(--sheet, #fbfdfc)); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .ds-num { font-weight: 500; text-align: right; } .ds-weak { color: var(--failed, #a23f3c); font-weight: 600; text-align: right; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A label in Quiet Ink above a pill number input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-2, #4d5f62); } .ds-input { font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; width: 4.5rem; color: var(--ink, #1d2b2e); background: var(--sheet, #fbfdfc); border: 1px solid var(--edge, #6f7f80); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #1d2b2e) 8%, var(--sheet, #fbfdfc)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2c6769); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Old Solution Box
components.description: A monospace box with the ground tone, inside the sheet.
components.css: .ds-sol-sheet { background: var(--sheet, #fbfdfc); padding: 1rem; border-radius: 1.25rem; } .ds-pre { margin: 0; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; max-height: 24rem; overflow: auto; font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink, #1d2b2e); border-radius: 0.75rem; background: var(--paper, #e9f0ef); }

narrative.overview: The page is one Operate surface. It is a daily review list for one owner. He sits at a laptop with another site open beside it. He reads what to solve, solves it elsewhere, comes back, and presses one rating. The look is a quiet pond. The ground is a misty blue-green. The work of today lies on one near-white sheet with round corners. The header, the topic index, and the table of all problems sit on the ground. The dark scheme is the pond at night: a green-black ground and a raised dark sheet. The page uses system fonts only. The content security policy allows no font file, no image from another host, and no inline style. Both color schemes follow the system setting.
keyCharacteristics: One sheet on the ground. Only Today lies on it.
Each control is a pill. Each small mark is a circle.
A rating is a color dot and a word.
Color is rare: the accent for the name and the numbers, and three rating colors.
Thin lines in a soft tone separate rows. No band, no shadow, no gradient.
Fixed sizes in rem from a short scale. No fluid type.
No authored motion. Hover is a tint in 150 milliseconds.

rules.name: The Hex Home Rule
rules.body: A hex color appears only in the two :root blocks. Every other rule uses var(...) or color-mix(...).

rules.name: The Word First Rule
rules.body: Color is a second signal. A dot always has its word next to it.

rules.name: The One Color Variable Rule
rules.body: A rating class sets --c to its rating color. The dot, the word, and the button ground all read --c.

rules.name: The Short Scale Rule
rules.body: Only these sizes exist in rem: 0.75, 0.8125, 0.875, 1, 1.1875, 1.375, and 1.5. A test in tests/static.test.js reads the sizes in styles.css.

rules.name: The Four Weights Rule
rules.body: Weights are 400, 500, 600, and 700. The status of a due entry steps through them to show how late it is. The status text carries the meaning.

rules.name: The Tone Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Do not add box-shadow, a gradient, or a blur. A test in tests/static.test.js fails on each of them.

dos: Do show a rating as a dot and a word. The words are Clean, Struggled, and Failed.
Do keep one sheet. Other sections sit on the ground.
Do put every color in the two :root blocks and use var(...) after that.
Do keep the sizes of the short scale and the four radius values.
Do keep hover as an 8 percent tint in 150 milliseconds and active as a 14 percent tint.
Do keep transition: none under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Do give each class a selector. A test in tests/styles.test.js checks it.
Do keep each control reachable by keyboard with the 2 pixel focus outline.
Do keep text contrast at 4.5 to 1 or more in both schemes.
donts: Do not add a band, a shadow, a gradient, or a blur.
Do not add @font-face, @import, @keyframes, a font file, an image, or an inline style. The content security policy blocks them.
Do not add authored motion. The page redraws after each action, so nothing moves on load or on a press.
Do not use color as the only signal for a state.
Do not use a serif face, capitals for labels, or letter spacing.
Do not turn the page into cards, rings, or a dashboard with alarm colors.
Do not use the look or the logo of NeetCode.
